about_the_game:
The Soundtrack of 7 Days features 84 tracks composed primarily by Daver The Dave. This Soundtrack blends ambient, alternative, orchestral, and game soundtrack music into something that brings to the whole experience of the game. As a bonus, it also includes music from the trailers.

"Almost Fantasy" written by Fog Lake

"The Last Rose of Summer" recorded by Davis, H & Moore, S (1922)

"Burn" by Joe Kenyon

"A Place I've Lived In" by Three Lices and A Molly

"Out Of My Head" written by Luka Reijnders

"7 Days" performed by Snechu and Jenna

All other songs were written, recorded and produced by Daver The Dave (IC Industries)

The Sountrack is available to stream on streaming services.
